what: Floors the shipped model's committed metrics must stay above; tests/test_eval_gate.py fails CI otherwise. Set on 2026-10-23 a few points under the evaluated values, so noise passes and a real regression fails. The gate reads committed results files, not a model: a regression fails CI once worse numbers are committed. Macro AUROC was added after review, as PLAN asks; the review workload floor reads the test split, because validation's share is 5% by construction.
